###############################################################################
# TJ IAM user + least-privilege "GlacierEFSEC2" customer-managed policy
#
# Scope of this configuration:
#   * one IAM user ("TJ") - no access keys / long-lived credentials are created
#   * one customer-managed policy ("GlacierEFSEC2") built from an explicit,
#     auditable aws_iam_policy_document (no Service:* wildcards)
#   * one Glacier vault, used to scope the Glacier statements to a real ARN
#   * no AWS-managed policies are attached anywhere
#
# NOTE: the AWS provider configuration and the state backend are managed by the
# deployment harness, so no `provider` and no `backend` block appear here.
###############################################################################

terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.5.0"

  required_providers {
    aws = {
      source  = "hashicorp/aws"
      version = "~> 5.0"
    }
  }
}

###############################################################################
# Local values
###############################################################################

locals {
  # Single source of truth for the region every permission is constrained to.
  # This matches the region of the (externally injected) AWS provider config.
  aws_region = "us-east-1"

  # Name of the Glacier vault created below; its ARN is used to scope the
  # Glacier statements of the IAM policy.
  glacier_vault_name = "tj-glacier-archive"

  # Tags applied consistently to every taggable resource in this stack.
  common_tags = {
    Environment = "production"
    ManagedBy   = "terraform"
    Project     = "tj-ec2-efs-glacier"
  }
}

###############################################################################
# Customer-managed policy document: GlacierEFSEC2
#
# Every statement declares an explicit Sid, an explicit Effect, an explicit
# Action list and an explicit Resource. No statement pairs a full "*" action
# with a "*" resource.
###############################################################################

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "glacier_efs_ec2" {
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # EC2 management (control plane)
  #
  # Resource = "*" justification: the EC2 actions in this statement are
  # regional control-plane operations. Describe*, RunInstances, CreateVolume,
  # CreateSnapshot, CreateKeyPair and CreateSecurityGroup do not support
  # resource-level ARN scoping, and in this greenfield account there are no
  # pre-existing instances, volumes, snapshots, key pairs or security groups to
  # scope to. The statement is therefore intentionally broad on Resource, but
  # it is (a) an explicitly enumerated action list - never "ec2:*" - and
  # (b) restricted to us-east-1 through the aws:RequestedRegion condition key.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  statement {
    sid    = "EC2ManagementInUsEast1"
    effect = "Allow"

    actions = [
      "ec2:Describe*",
      "ec2:RunInstances",
      "ec2:StartInstances",
      "ec2:StopInstances",
      "ec2:RebootInstances",
      "ec2:TerminateInstances",
      "ec2:CreateTags",
      "ec2:DeleteTags",
      "ec2:CreateVolume",
      "ec2:AttachVolume",
      "ec2:DetachVolume",
      "ec2:DeleteVolume",
      "ec2:CreateSnapshot",
      "ec2:DeleteSnapshot",
      "ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress",
      "ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress",
      "ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress",
      "ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress",
      "ec2:CreateKeyPair",
      "ec2:DeleteKeyPair",
      "ec2:CreateSecurityGroup",
      "ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup",
    ]

    resources = ["*"]

    condition {
      test     = "StringEquals"
      variable = "aws:RequestedRegion"
      values   = [local.aws_region]
    }
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # EFS descriptive (read-only) permissions
  #
  # These are account/region-level describe calls that do not support
  # resource-level ARN scoping, so Resource = "*" is required.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  statement {
    sid    = "EFSDescribe"
    effect = "Allow"

    actions = [
      "elasticfilesystem:DescribeFileSystems",
      "elasticfilesystem:DescribeMountTargets",
      "elasticfilesystem:DescribeAccessPoints",
      "elasticfilesystem:DescribeTags",
      "elasticfilesystem:ListTagsForResource",
    ]

    resources = ["*"]
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # EFS client-mount (data plane) permissions
  #
  # Resource = "*" justification: ClientMount/ClientWrite/ClientRootAccess are
  # normally scoped to a file-system ARN, but no EFS file system is provisioned
  # by this configuration (and none exists in this greenfield account), so no
  # file-system ARN can be referenced. The wildcard is applied to these three
  # data-plane actions only.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  statement {
    sid    = "EFSClientMount"
    effect = "Allow"

    actions = [
      "elasticfilesystem:ClientMount",
      "elasticfilesystem:ClientWrite",
      "elasticfilesystem:ClientRootAccess",
    ]

    resources = ["*"]
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Glacier vault and archive management, scoped to the vault created by this
  # configuration (aws_glacier_vault.archive.arn) - no unscoped vault ARNs and
  # no hardcoded account IDs.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  statement {
    sid    = "GlacierVaultAndArchiveManagement"
    effect = "Allow"

    actions = [
      "glacier:CreateVault",
      "glacier:DescribeVault",
      "glacier:GetVaultAccessPolicy",
      "glacier:SetVaultAccessPolicy",
      "glacier:ListTagsForVault",
      "glacier:InitiateMultipartUpload",
      "glacier:UploadMultipartPart",
      "glacier:CompleteMultipartUpload",
      "glacier:AbortMultipartUpload",
      "glacier:ListParts",
      "glacier:ListMultipartUploads",
      "glacier:UploadArchive",
      "glacier:InitiateJob",
      "glacier:DescribeJob",
      "glacier:ListJobs",
      "glacier:GetJobOutput",
    ]

    resources = [aws_glacier_vault.archive.arn]
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Glacier vault listing
  #
  # Resource = "*" justification: glacier:ListVaults is an account-level
  # enumeration call that does not support resource-level ARN scoping. It is
  # read-only and only reveals vault metadata to an already authorised caller.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  statement {
    sid       = "GlacierListVaults"
    effect    = "Allow"
    actions   = ["glacier:ListVaults"]
    resources = ["*"]
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Explicit guard rail: the workload is upload/read oriented, so destruction of
  # vaults and archives is denied outright (defence in depth on top of the fact
  # that those actions are never granted above).
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  statement {
    sid    = "DenyGlacierDeleteOperations"
    effect = "Deny"

    actions = [
      "glacier:DeleteVault",
      "glacier:DeleteArchive",
    ]

    resources = ["*"]
  }
}

###############################################################################
# Glacier vault (target of the scoped Glacier statements)
###############################################################################

resource "aws_glacier_vault" "archive" {
  name = local.glacier_vault_name

  tags = merge(local.common_tags, {
    Name = local.glacier_vault_name
  })

  # Vault contents are durable data: never let an accidental plan destroy them.
  lifecycle {
    prevent_destroy = true
  }
}

###############################################################################
# IAM user "TJ"
#
# No aws_iam_access_key is created: no long-lived programmatic credentials are
# requested and no secret material is ever written to configuration or state.
###############################################################################

resource "aws_iam_user" "tj" {
  name = "TJ"
  path = "/"

  tags = merge(local.common_tags, {
    Name = "TJ"
  })
}

###############################################################################
# Customer-managed policy "GlacierEFSEC2"
###############################################################################

resource "aws_iam_policy" "glacier_efs_ec2" {
  name        = "GlacierEFSEC2"
  description = "Least-privilege EC2 management (us-east-1 only), EFS client-mount, and Glacier vault/archive permissions for the TJ IAM user."
  policy      = data.aws_iam_policy_document.glacier_efs_ec2.json

  tags = merge(local.common_tags, {
    Name = "GlacierEFSEC2"
  })
}

###############################################################################
# Attachment (attachment resource, not the destructive
# aws_iam_policy_attachment, and not an inline aws_iam_user_policy)
###############################################################################

resource "aws_iam_user_policy_attachment" "tj_glacier_efs_ec2" {
  user       = aws_iam_user.tj.name
  policy_arn = aws_iam_policy.glacier_efs_ec2.arn
}

###############################################################################
# Outputs (non-sensitive identifiers only)
###############################################################################

output "iam_user_name" {
  description = "Name of the created IAM user."
  value       = aws_iam_user.tj.name
}

output "iam_user_arn" {
  description = "ARN of the created IAM user."
  value       = aws_iam_user.tj.arn
}

output "iam_policy_arn" {
  description = "ARN of the customer-managed GlacierEFSEC2 policy."
  value       = aws_iam_policy.glacier_efs_ec2.arn
}

final_template:
terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.0"

  required_providers {
    aws = {
      source  = "hashicorp/aws"
      version = "~> 5.0"
    }
  }
}

provider "aws" {
  region = "us-east-1"
}

data "aws_caller_identity" "current" {}

data "aws_partition" "current" {}

data "aws_region" "current" {}

locals {
  account_id = data.aws_caller_identity.current.account_id
  partition  = data.aws_partition.current.partition
  region     = data.aws_region.current.name

  standard_tags = {
    ManagedBy = "Terraform"
    Project   = "iam-access-management"
    Stack     = "iam-access-management"
  }

  arn_acm_certificate          = "arn:${local.partition}:acm:${local.region}:${local.account_id}:certificate/*"
  arn_cloudfront_distribution  = "arn:${local.partition}:cloudfront::${local.account_id}:distribution/*"
  arn_cloudfront_oai           = "arn:${local.partition}:cloudfront::${local.account_id}:origin-access-identity/*"
  arn_lambda_function          = "arn:${local.partition}:lambda:${local.region}:${local.account_id}:function:*"
  arn_logs_log_group           = "arn:${local.partition}:logs:${local.region}:${local.account_id}:log-group:*"
  arn_route53_hosted_zone      = "arn:${local.partition}:route53:::hostedzone/*"
  arn_s3_bucket                = "arn:${local.partition}:s3:::*"
  arn_sqs_queue                = "arn:${local.partition}:sqs:${local.region}:${local.account_id}:*"
  arn_iam_serverless_role_path = "arn:${local.partition}:iam::${local.account_id}:role/serverless/*"
}

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "admin" {
  statement {
    sid       = "FullAdministrativeAccess"
    effect    = "Allow"
    actions   = ["*"]
    resources = ["*"]
  }
}

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "admin_terraform_cloud" {
  statement {
    sid       = "FullAdministrativeAccessForTerraformCloud"
    effect    = "Allow"
    actions   = ["*"]
    resources = ["*"]
  }
}
